flags: Surrozen discontinued development of SZN-043 in severe alcohol associated hepatitis.
Surrozen entered into the two-tranche 2025 PIPE for gross proceeds of $175.0 million and closed the first tranche for aggregate net proceeds of $71.2 million.
Warrants to purchase up to 8,772,848 shares of common stock were cancelled in connection with the 2025 PIPE.

business_model.claim: Surrozen is a clinical-stage biotechnology company developing Wnt-modulating antibody therapeutics for ophthalmic diseases and has generated no revenue from product sales to date.
quotes: We are a biotechnology company committed to discovering and developing product candidates to selectively modulate the Wnt pathway, a critical mediator of tissue repair.
To date, we have not generated any revenue from product sales, and have not sought or obtained regulatory approval for any product candidate.

business_model.claim: To date, Surrozen has generated revenue solely from licensing and research collaborations rather than commercial product sales.
quotes: To date, we have only generated revenue from licensing and research collaborations.

business_model.claim: Under its Collaboration and License Agreement, Surrozen granted Boehringer Ingelheim an exclusive worldwide license to Fzd4 bi-specific antibodies including SZN-413 in exchange for a $12.5 million upfront payment, up to $587.0 million in success-based milestones, and mid-single digit to low-double digit royalties on net sales.
quotes: Under the CLA, Boehringer Ingelheim has an exclusive, royalty-bearing, worldwide, sublicensable license, under our applicable patents and know-how, to develop, manufacture and commercialize, for all uses, one lead and two back-up Fzd4 bi-specific antibodies selected by Boehringer Ingelheim.

Under the terms of the CLA, Boehringer Ingelheim paid us a non-refundable upfront payment of $12.5 million less applicable withholding tax and agreed to pay success-based milestone payments up to $587.0 million and mid-single digit to low-double digit royalties on net sales of the licensed products should any reach commercialization.

business_model.claim: Collaboration and license revenue is episodic and driven by milestone triggers under the Boehringer Ingelheim agreement, including a $5.0 million research milestone and a $10.0 million development milestone triggered in 2026.
quotes: In March 2026, Boehringer Ingelheim achieved a research milestone, reflecting a positive outcome of the IND-enabling GLP toxicology study, which triggered a $5.0 million milestone payment to us.
In June 2026, Boehringer Ingelheim achieved a development milestone following the initiation of a Phase 1 study, which triggered a $10.0 million payment to us.
During the three and nine months ended September 30, 2026, we recognized zero and $10.0 million, respectively, as collaboration and license revenue under the CLA.

business_model.claim: Surrozen previously earned research service revenue by providing antibody discovery services to related party TCGFB, Inc. for up to $6.0 million in fixed monthly fees plus third-party costs and a warrant, before terminating the collaboration in November 2025.
quotes: In exchange for our research services, TCGFB agreed to pay us a fixed monthly fee up to $6.0 million in the aggregate, plus any third-party costs, and issued us a warrant exercisable for up to 3.4 million shares of TCGFB common stock at an exercise price of $0.0001 per share based on certain vesting conditions.

Research service revenue from a related party was zero for the quarter ended September 30, 2026, compared to $1.0 million for the same period in 2025 as a result of the termination of the research collaboration with TCGFB, Inc., effective November 2025.

business_model.basis: stated in P1, P2, and P5
business_model.claim: Surrozen retains wholly owned ophthalmology candidates outside the Boehringer Ingelheim agreement, including SZN-8141 in clinical development for diabetic macular edema and SZN-8143 in preclinical development, though none are approved for commercial sale.
quotes: Beyond our work with Boehringer Ingelheim on SZN-413, we also have multiple novel ophthalmology product candidates targeting Fzd4 which have demonstrated proof-of-concept in preclinical studies.
These product candidates do not fall within the scope of the CLA with Boehringer Ingelheim and are wholly owned by us.
We received FDA clearance of our IND application for SZN-8141 in October 2026 and have dosed our first patient in a Phase 1b/2a study in patients with DME called DUET.

business_model.claim: Because collaboration payments do not cover operating expenses, Surrozen finances its business primarily by issuing equity securities alongside collaboration and license payments.
quotes: Historically, we have financed our operations primarily through the sales of our equity securities and the payments received under our collaboration and license agreements.
We incurred significant operating losses and negative cash flows from operations.

business_model.basis: stated in F2, P3, and P8
business_model.claim: Research and development is Surrozen's largest operating expense at 28,649 (table in thousands) in the first nine months of 2026, driven by external CRO, manufacturing, lab, and consulting costs for its ophthalmology programs plus internal personnel and stock-based compensation.
quotes: We classify operating expenses into two main categories: (i) research and development expenses and (ii) general and administrative expenses.
Our research and development expenses consist of external and internal expenses incurred in connection with our research activities and development programs.

R&D expenses were $10.8 million for the quarter ended September 30, 2026, compared to $7.8 million for the same period in 2025, primarily reflecting a $2.1 million increase in research and manufacturing costs for the Company’s ophthalmology programs and a $0.9 million increase in employee-related expenses primarily related to stock-based compensation.

business_model.claim: Management expects research and development expenses to rise in the near term as Surrozen advances clinical trials, including expanding the DUET trial from approximately 60 to 150 patients, and validates manufacturing processes.
quotes: Specifically, in the near term we expect to incur substantial expenses relating to our clinical trials, the development and validation of our manufacturing processes, and other research and development activities.
Surrozen plans to expand the randomized, double-masked Phase 2a portion of DUET from approximately 60 to 150 patients.

business_model.basis: stated in F2, P3, and P8
business_model.claim: General and administrative expenses totaled 19,819 (table in thousands) in the first nine months of 2026 and are driven by administrative personnel and stock-based compensation, legal and intellectual property fees, professional services, and public-company compliance costs.
quotes: General and administrative expenses consist primarily of personnel-related costs, including salaries, bonuses, benefits and stock-based compensation expense for personnel in executive, finance, human resources, business and corporate development, legal, information technology and other administrative functions.

General and administrative expenses also include legal, audit, tax and other consulting fees, investor relations services, insurance costs, and facility costs not otherwise included in research and development expenses, and costs associated with compliance with the rules and regulations of the SEC and Nasdaq.

G&A expenses were $6.8 million for the quarter ended September 30, 2026, compared to $4.1 million for the same period in 2025, due to a $1.7 million increase in employee-related expenses primarily related to stock-based compensation and a $0.9 million increase in professional service fees, primarily related to intellectual property portfolio legal fees.

business_model.claim: Below operating expenses, Surrozen's GAAP net loss is heavily moved by non-cash fair value remeasurements of tranche and warrant liabilities, totaling $171.4 million in noncash loss in the nine months ended September 30, 2026, which are primarily driven by changes in the company's stock price.
quotes: During the three and nine months ended September 30, 2026, we had net loss of $129.7 million and $207.1 million, including noncash loss of $113.0 million and $171.4 million on changes in fair value of tranche liability and warrant liabilities during the period, respectively.

Loss on change in fair value of tranche liability represents the non-cash change in fair value of tranche liability, which was primarily driven by the increase in our stock price from the initial measurement date.

business_model.claim: Surrozen outsources preclinical studies, clinical trials, and biologic manufacturing to third parties, and holds third-party patent and research licenses that could require milestone fees and royalties upon further development or product sales.
quotes: We rely on third parties to conduct our preclinical studies and clinical trials, and those third parties may not perform satisfactorily.
Upon the achievement of further regulatory and developmental milestones and the sale of licensed products, we may incur significant fees and royalties under these licenses.

competitive_position.basis: stated in the cited item (10-K Item 1 Business)
competitive_position.claim: Surrozen positions itself as potentially the first developer to manufacture synthetic, soluble Wnt mimetics using its proprietary SWAP antibody-engineering platform to overcome hydrophobicity and selectivity obstacles of natural Wnt proteins.
quotes: We believe we are potentially the first developer to manufacture synthetic, soluble Wnt mimetics.
Unlike our antibodies, Wnt proteins are highly hydrophobic, making them difficult to express, solubilize and purify.

competitive_position.basis: stated in the cited items (10-K Item 1 Business and 10-Q MD&A)
competitive_position.claim: Surrozen differentiates its wholly owned ophthalmology candidates SZN-8141 and SZN-8143 from single-mechanism agents by combining Fzd4-mediated Wnt agonism with VEGF antagonism, and additionally IL-6 antagonism in SZN-8143.
quotes: These product candidates do not fall within the scope of the CLA with Boehringer Ingelheim and are wholly owned by us.

SZN-8141 combines Frizzled 4, or Fzd4, agonism and vascular endothelial growth factor, or VEGF, antagonism and has the potential to provide benefits over treatment with single mechanism agents against these targets.
SZN-8143 combines Fzd4 agonism, VEGF antagonism, and interleukin-6, or IL-6, antagonism and may have benefits over single mechanism agents against these targets.

competitive_position.basis: stated in the cited items (10-Q MD&A and 8-K earnings release)
competitive_position.claim: Wnt pathway activation in retinal vascular disease has clinical validation from Merck's competing Fzd4 monotherapy remigromig (MK-3000), while current standard of care already includes anti-VEGF monotherapies and dual-pathway VEGF/Ang-2 agents such as Vabysmo.
quotes: The current standard of care for diabetic retinopathy (including DME), retinal vein occlusion and wet AMD is intravitreal administration of anti-VEGF therapies, including monotherapies and dual-pathway agents targeting VEGF and Ang-2.

In addition, Merck’s remigromig, a FZD4-mediated Wnt agonist monotherapy, achieved its primary endpoint in a Phase 2b/3 clinical trial in DME, supporting the therapeutic potential of Wnt pathway activation in retinal vascular disease.

competitive_position.basis: stated in the cited items (10-Q MD&A, 8-K earnings release, and 8-K Item 8.01)
competitive_position.claim: Surrozen advanced SZN-8141 into clinical testing following FDA IND clearance and first-patient dosing in the DUET Phase 1b/2a study in DME, with plans to expand Phase 2a enrollment from approximately 60 to 150 patients.
quotes: We received FDA clearance of our IND application for SZN-8141 in October 2026 and have dosed our first patient in a Phase 1b/2a study in patients with DME called DUET.
Surrozen plans to expand the randomized, double-masked Phase 2a portion of DUET from approximately 60 to 150 patients.

competitive_position.basis: stated in the cited items (10-Q statement of operations, 10-K MD&A, and 10-Q MD&A)
competitive_position.claim: Surrozen's Collaboration and License Agreement with Boehringer Ingelheim for SZN-413 provides external validation and non-dilutive milestone funding, including up to $587.0 million in success-based milestones and a $10.0 million milestone triggered by Phase 1 initiation.
quotes: Under the terms of the CLA, Boehringer Ingelheim paid us a non-refundable upfront payment of $12.5 million less applicable withholding tax and agreed to pay success-based milestone payments up to $587.0 million and mid-single digit to low-double digit royalties on net sales of the licensed products should any reach commercialization.
In June 2026, Boehringer Ingelheim achieved a development milestone following the initiation of a Phase 1 study, which triggered a $10.0 million payment to us.

competitive_position.basis: stated in the cited items (10-Q liquidity disclosure, 8-K earnings release, and 8-K offering announcement)
competitive_position.claim: Recent equity financings, including net proceeds totaling approximately $118.9 million from the second PIPE tranche and ATM sales plus an underwritten offering expected to raise approximately $60 million in gross proceeds, support an anticipated cash runway into 2029.
quotes: Second tranche of March 2025 PIPE and ATM transaction totaling approximately $118.9 million in net proceeds in October 2026 extend anticipated cash runway into 2029
We anticipate a cash runway into 2029, including funding for completion of the DUET Phase 1b/2a study of SZN-8141 and initial Phase 1b clinical development of SZN-8143.
The gross proceeds from the Offering are expected to be approximately $60 million before deducting underwriting discounts and commissions and other offering expenses payable by the Company.

competitive_position.basis: stated in the cited items (10-K Item 1 and Item 1A, 10-Q Item 1A and liquidity disclosure)
competitive_position.claim: A central threat to Surrozen's competitive position is that none of its product candidates have received regulatory approval, it generates no product sales revenue, and clinical failures can force program discontinuation as occurred with SZN-043.
quotes: None of our product candidates have received regulatory approval; our ability to achieve and sustain profitability depends on obtaining regulatory approval and successfully commercializing product candidates, either alone or with collaborators.
To date, we have not generated any revenue from product sales, and have not sought or obtained regulatory approval for any product candidate.
In the first quarter of 2025, we discontinued development of SZN-043 in severe alcohol associated hepatitis.

competitive_position.basis: stated in the cited items (10-K and 10-Q Item 1A Risk Factors)
competitive_position.claim: Surrozen faces direct competitive threats from companies developing competing therapeutics or platforms that could reach approval faster, prove more effective, or cause fewer side effects.
quotes: We face competition from entities that have developed or may develop product candidates for the treatment of the diseases that we may target, including companies developing novel treatments and therapeutic platforms.

If these companies develop therapeutics or product candidates more rapidly than we do, or if their therapeutics or product candidates are more effective or have fewer side effects, our ability to develop and successfully commercialize product candidates may be adversely affected.

competitive_position.basis: stated in the cited item (10-K Item 1A Risk Factors)
competitive_position.claim: Safety and tolerability risks associated with Wnt pathway modulation—including prior observations of asymptomatic transaminase elevations in humans and noted theoretical risks of tumor formation or proliferation—threaten clinical progression and approvability.
quotes: For example, although our lead product candidates exhibited encouraging results in animal studies, they may not demonstrate the same properties in humans and may interact with human physiology in unforeseen, ineffective or harmful ways, as shown by the observations of asymptomatic transaminase elevations.
For example, certain researchers have noted that therapeutics targeting the Wnt pathway may lead to tumor formation or proliferation as a result of the downstream impacts of Wnt signaling.

competitive_position.basis: stated in the cited items (10-K and 10-Q Item 1A Risk Factors)
competitive_position.claim: Operational execution is threatened by reliance on third-party CROs and contract manufacturers, complex biologic production and CMC scale-up challenges, and dependence on Boehringer Ingelheim's performance under the CLA.
quotes: The manufacturing of our product candidates is complex.
We and our third-party manufacturers may encounter difficulties in production.
We rely on third parties to conduct our preclinical studies and clinical trials, and those third parties may not perform satisfactorily.
If those collaborations are not successful, we may not be able to capitalize on the market potential of our product candidates.

competitive_position.basis: stated in the cited items (10-K and 10-Q Item 1A Risk Factors)
competitive_position.claim: Surrozen's exclusivity is exposed to intellectual property risks, including potential inability to obtain or protect adequate patent rights and federal march-in rights or U.S. manufacturing preferences on in-licensed IP from government-funded programs.
quotes: If we are unable to obtain or protect intellectual property rights related to our technology and current or future product candidates, or if our intellectual property rights are inadequate, we may not be able to compete effectively.

Some intellectual property that we have in-licensed may have been discovered through government funded programs and thus may be subject to federal regulations such as “march-in” rights, certain reporting requirements and a preference for U.S.-based companies.

competitive_position.basis: stated in the cited items (10-Q balance sheet and liquidity disclosure, 10-K and 10-Q Risk Factors)
competitive_position.claim: Ongoing operating losses and an accumulated deficit of $734.3 million create long-term financing risk that could force dilutive equity issuances or scaling back R&D programs if future capital cannot be raised on acceptable terms.
quotes: As of September 30, 2026, we had cash and cash equivalents of $100.4 million and accumulated deficit of $734.3 million.

If we are unable to obtain additional funding from these or other sources when needed, we may need to significantly reduce expenses through reductions in staff and delaying, scaling back operations, or stopping certain research and development programs.
Any future equity or debt issuances or other financing transactions may have dilutive or adverse effects on our existing stockholders.

competitive_position.basis: stated in the cited items (10-K and 10-Q Item 1A Risk Factors)
competitive_position.claim: Even if regulatory approval is achieved, commercial viability is threatened by market acceptance, pricing against alternative treatments, payor reimbursement, foreign regulatory hurdles, and international trade barriers such as tariffs and sanctions.
quotes: Even if regulatory approval is obtained for a product candidate, we may not generate or sustain revenue from sales of approved products.
International trade policies, including tariffs, sanctions and trade barriers may adversely affect our business, financial condition, results of operations and prospects.

quotes: Our proprietary platform, SWAPs, enables us to potently and selectively modulate Wnt signaling through the generation of Wnt mimetics.

growth_thesis.claim: Pipeline-driven growth requires product candidates to demonstrate safety, purity, potency, and clinical efficacy in human trials without unacceptable side effects such as tumor formation or transaminase elevations.
quotes: Our product candidates that are tested in humans may not demonstrate the safety, purity and potency, or efficacy, necessary to become approvable or commercially viable.

growth_thesis.claim: Commercial revenue growth cannot occur unless Surrozen or a collaborator obtains FDA or foreign regulatory approvals, executes clinical trials, and maintains reliable third-party manufacturing.

Before obtaining regulatory approval for the commercial distribution of our product candidates, we or a collaborator must conduct extensive preclinical studies, followed by clinical trials to demonstrate the safety, purity and potency, or efficacy of our product candidates in humans.
We rely on third parties to conduct our preclinical studies and clinical trials, and those third parties may not perform satisfactorily.
